name: Jolywood (Suzhou) Sunwatt Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jolywood (Suzhou) Sunwatt Co.,Ltd. develops, produces, and sells solar energy materials worldwide. It provides solar energy materials, including plastic flexible films, as well as solar energy materials; solar energy technology services; and consulting. The company's products include solar cell backsheets, solar cells and modules, photovoltaic application systems, power plant business, and photovoltaic power plant generation. It also imports and exports goods and technologies. The company was formerly known as Jolywood (Suzhou) Solar Material Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Jolywood (Suzhou) Sunwatt Co., Ltd. in 2011.
